Declaration dependencies from https://github.com/ntrtwl/NitroSystem, commit d636fb5d2b212e8736f09859fff447be2bd0ac85. Only freshly compiled C function bodies with complete local byte equality are counted; assembly bodies are excluded. Headers and the generated fx_const.h are pinned in verification/sdk-header-manifest.json. Source provenance, build flags and original function addresses are recorded in verification/sdk-source-proofs.json. Whole-ROM linking and global ABI remain unverified.
